objective: Fix multiple bugs: (1) search profile title/industry changes not reflecting in searches, (2) progress bar showing '14 of 14' instead of incremental count, (3) PF searches using stale profile data, (4) CV extraction overwriting user-entered fields, (5) PF deduplicating job titles, (6) connection timeout losing results, (7) PF 'Show results now' running extra round, (8) ATS trackers in URLs not blocked, (9) filtered summary not showing during PF, (10) bebee.com related domains not blocked
plan: Fix progress bar: change event.total to event.current in analyzing_job case
Add cache-busting headers to search-pill profile fetches
Clear continuation token when search profile is saved
Add visual confirmation in profile editors that changes apply to next search
Re-fetch search profile on resume (both regular and PF)
Rebuild PF title/industry chains from refreshed profile on resume
Only auto-fill empty fields during CV extraction
Skip deduplication for PF mode to preserve title ladder
Add connection interrupted modal with recovered results
PF loop exits immediately when finish_now=true
Check job URLs for ATS trackers (not just description/spec)
Show filtered summary at PF pauses and regular search pause
Add bebee.com related domains to blocklist

actions.description: Fixed progress bar in dashboard/page.tsx:544 - changed event.total to event.current
actions.key_decision: Used event.current from API response instead of event.total for incremental display

actions.description: Added cache-busting headers to search-pill.tsx and mobile-search-pill.tsx
actions.key_decision: Added Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate headers to Supabase queries

actions.description: Clear continuation token on profile save via fmsg-profile-saved event + localStorage
actions.key_decision: Custom event + localStorage to clear stale continuation token when profile data changes

actions.description: Add visual confirmation 'Saved — changes apply to your next search' in profile editors
actions.key_decision: Added animate-fade-in CSS and success message state in both desktop and mobile editors

actions.description: Re-fetch search profile on resume (both regular and PF searches)
actions.key_decision: After decoding continuation token, re-fetch search_profiles to get latest job_titles, industry steps, cv_variations

actions.description: Rebuild PF title/industry chains from refreshed profile on resume
actions.key_decision: When resuming PF, rebuild titleChainSteps and industryChain from refreshed state.titles and state.industryStep1-5 instead of using stale token data

actions.description: CV extraction only auto-fills empty fields (job titles, location, industry, industry ladder steps)
actions.key_decision: Check if field is empty/default before overwriting with extracted data

actions.description: Skip deduplication for PF mode to preserve title ladder (each round gets one title)
actions.key_decision: Only deduplicate for regular search rotation; PF uses all 5 titles for 5-round broadening

actions.description: Add connection interrupted modal with recovered results for Vercel 300s timeout
actions.key_decision: Fetch partial results from DB on stream end, show modal with recovered count and OK button

actions.description: PF loop exits immediately when finish_now=true (Show results now)
ATS tracker detection now checks job URLs (not just description/spec)
actions.key_decision: Added URL checking to both pre-filter and post-scrape filter using buildJobUrl()

actions.description: Show filtered summary at actionable pauses (regular search pause, PF round pauses, timeout, finish_now)
actions.key_decision: Send filtered_summary at pause points only, not during active rounds

actions.description: Add bebee.com related domains to blocklist
actions.key_decision: Added 8 regional bebee subdomains (co.za, co.uk, fr, it, es, de, com.au, ca)

key_decisions: Root cause for profile persistence: continuation token cached stale profile state when user paused search → edited profile → continued
Fix strategy for profile: clear continuation token on profile save via custom event + localStorage, re-fetch on resume
Progress bar bug: dashboard/page.tsx:544 used event.total for both current and total
PF title ladder broken by deduplicateTitles collapsing 5 distinct titles into 1 broad title
ATS tracker #J-18808-Ljbffr was in job URL, not description/spec
Filtered summary should only show at pause points where user can act, not during active rounds
